capabilities: Identify chords by ear in listen training
Configure sessions by intervals, chords, mode, and exercise count
Save training results to Markdown files
Replay and review answers with keyboard shortcuts
extras: Settings customization is described as still in development, and saved result files are noted as not very customizable yet.
motivation: The author built it to improve their own musical ear and implemented their personal solution as an Obsidian plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to practice aural skills like interval and chord recognition, so musicians must leave the app or use separate tools.
summary: Ear training plugin that runs interval and chord recognition exercises inside Obsidian and saves results to notes.
